releaseNotes:
### Workspace Experience

- Redesign workspace content tab controls: the close button now overlays the tab icon on hover, maximizing visible title width for browser and document tabs.
- Refine horizontal scroll overflow masks with compact, smooth transitions.
- Compact toolbar icon button spacing and align macOS traffic light inset for a cleaner visual rhythm.

### Conversation & Collaboration

- Introduce session avatar displays across collaboration and workspace views for clearer identity distinction.
- Stabilize transcript tool disclosures, message virtualizer scrolling, and layout resizing behavior.
- Support branching new conversations from pasted-text sessions.
- Open local HTML files in workspace browser tabs directly from markdown links.

### Models & Compatibility

- Update MiMo model presets to v2.6.
- Standardize OpenAI content filter response handling in core daemon.
- Maintain full compatibility with schema version 24; no database migration is required from 0.3.8.
